It is observed that there is an issue raised by Petitioner with respect to scope of work. We observe that it is necessary to adjudicate the dispute regarding scope of work at this stage before COD of the project. Hence the Petition has been admitted only to the extent of the Petitioner’s prayers relating to the scope of work under RfP and TSA and consequential change in Law, if any, and respondents were also directed to file their responses limited to these aspects only. Accordingly, the prayers (m) to (q) as noted at Paragraph 3 of this Order have been adjudicated upon in the instant Order.
